data.name: Damarion
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Greek 'Damas' (tamed) and 'Rion' (mountain). The name Damarion signifies 'God's tamed mountain'. In the Bible, this name is not explicitly mentioned, but it may be derived from the name Damascus, which is believed to mean 'tamed' or 'subdued'.
